problem: The food bank is getting ready for a busy Saturday. So that families can grab their groceries quickly, volunteers set out 6 tables and put 8 bags on each one. What is the total number of bags on the tables?

follow_ups.question: By noon, 29 of the bags have been picked up. How many are still waiting?

problem: Just before the holidays, Ms Haddad opens a delivery box at the post office counter. Inside she finds 7 sheets of stamps, 24 stamps to a sheet. Find how many stamps came in the delivery.

follow_ups.question: She sells 58 of them before lunch. What number of stamps does she still have?
In the afternoon, 5 more sheets of the same kind arrive. How many stamps does she have now?

problem: It is flu shot day at the clinic, and 12 people are already sitting in the waiting room. Nurse Ingrid lays out 7 trays with 5 bandages on each, so she never has to run to the cupboard. How many bandages are on the trays?

follow_ups.question: By lunchtime, 18 bandages have been used up. How many does she have left?

problem: Firefighters never leave the station without gloves, so spare pairs are kept in the lockers. Each of the 9 lockers holds 4 pairs. Altogether, how many pairs of spare gloves are there?
A truck pulls into the building site with bricks for a new garden wall. The driver unloads 6 pallets, and every pallet is stacked with 45 bricks. How many bricks have been delivered?

follow_ups.question: On the first day, the builders lay 85 of the bricks. How many are not laid yet?
The next day they lay 3 rows of 40 bricks. How many bricks are left after that?
The leftover bricks are stacked in piles of 5 behind the shed. How many piles are there?

problem: Kofi wants his rental bikes to be easy to see at night before the summer rush starts. He fits 4 reflectors to every bike, and there are 9 rental bikes in the back room. The shop cat likes to nap in the basket of the red bike. How many reflectors does Kofi fit?

follow_ups.question: Reflectors come in packets of 6. How many packets did he open?
Each packet cost 7 dollars. How much did Kofi spend on reflectors?

problem: Mother's Day is tomorrow, so the flower shop is making small bunches that children can afford. Rosa has finished 7 bunches so far. If each bunch has 6 tulips, how many tulips has she used?

follow_ups.question: To be ready for the morning rush, she wants 3 more bunches just like these. How many more tulips does she need?

problem: The pumpkin patch has been open for 5 years, and this fall the farmer wants a big display by the gate to welcome visitors. She lines up 8 rows of pumpkins, 14 in a row. How many pumpkins make up the display?

follow_ups.question: Visitors buy 47 of the display pumpkins on Saturday. How many remain?
She packs the rest into crates of 5 to keep them out of the rain. How many crates does she fill?

problem: At the county fair, the ring toss stand hands each player a basket of 3 rings. On Friday night, 9 children paid for a turn. How many rings were thrown that night?
Mr Nowak wants everyone in his class to run exactly one lap of the relay on sports day. He makes 5 teams of 4 runners. So how many runners are in the relay?

follow_ups.question: After the race, every runner gets 2 orange slices. How many slices does Mr Nowak hand out?

problem: The sewing club is making a quilt to raffle at the school fair. This term 8 members joined, and each of them sews 6 squares at home. What number of squares will the finished quilt have?

follow_ups.question: The squares are laid out in rows of 8. How many rows does the quilt have?
Every row gets 3 buttons sewn along its edge. How many buttons is that?
Buttons are sold on cards of 6. How many cards must the club buy?

problem: Leo is building a tower for his little sister, who loves knocking things down. The tower has 12 layers of 9 blocks each. His sister likes the green blocks best. How many blocks did Leo use?

follow_ups.question: Then Leo tops it with a pointed roof made of 15 more blocks. What is the total number of blocks now?

problem: The food bank has been helping the town for 16 years. This morning Mariam stacked soup cans on 5 shelves so they would be easy to reach, putting 9 cans on each shelf. How many cans did she stack?

follow_ups.question: Later she squeezes 2 more cans onto every shelf. How many cans are on the shelves now?
During the afternoon, families take home 30 cans. How many are left?

problem: The mail carrier's bag is extra heavy today because of a big online sale. Every one of the 8 streets on her route is getting 7 parcels. Work out how many parcels she has to deliver.

During Healthy Teeth Week, the children's clinic gives a free toothbrush to every child who visits. The dentist orders 16 boxes, and there are 6 toothbrushes in a box. How many toothbrushes does she order?

follow_ups.question: By Friday, 58 toothbrushes have been given out. How many are left for next week?

problem: The fire station is holding an open day, and the crew wants every visitor to have a seat for the safety talk. They set up chairs in 7 rows, putting 8 chairs in each row. What is the number of chairs they set up?

follow_ups.question: Only 49 people come to the talk. How many chairs stay empty?
Each visitor at the talk gets 2 stickers shaped like fire helmets. How many stickers are handed out?

problem: Workers at the building site are fitting windows into a new block of flats. The block is 5 floors high, with 6 windows on every floor. Find the number of windows they need.

follow_ups.question: So far 13 windows have been fitted. How many still have to go in?

problem: Mehmet's bike shop always runs out of inner tubes in spring, so he orders early. He asks for 6 cartons with 15 tubes in each, and they should arrive in 3 days. How many tubes is he ordering?

follow_ups.question: He hangs the tubes on hooks, 9 to a hook. How many hooks does he use?
In the first week he sells 27 tubes. How many tubes does he have left?
Each tube sells for 4 dollars. How much money will he get if he sells all the tubes that are left?

problem: Aiko helps at her aunt's flower shop on Saturdays. Today she is filling 6 vases for a wedding, and each vase needs 5 roses. The bride's dress is pale blue. Can you find how many roses Aiko needs?

The farmer at the pumpkin patch lets every visiting child pick 3 mini pumpkins to take home. On Tuesday a reading group of 8 children came out by bus. In all, how many mini pumpkins did the group take home?

follow_ups.question: On the way back, 5 of them rolled off the seats and got squashed. How many are still whole?
Back at school, the teacher adds 11 pumpkins from her own garden. How many pumpkins are on the classroom shelf now?

problem: The pie contest at the county fair has 4 judges, and there are 8 pies to try. Before choosing a winner, every judge tastes one slice from each pie. Find the total number of slices the judges eat.

follow_ups.question: Next year the fair will add 2 more judges, with the same number of pies. How many slices will be tasted then?

problem: On sports day the long-jump pit has to be raked smooth after every jump. There are 23 children in the long-jump group, and each child gets 3 jumps. How many times is the pit raked?

follow_ups.question: A volunteer rakes 17 of those times, and a teacher does the rest. How many times does the teacher rake?
Each raking takes the teacher 2 minutes. How many minutes does she spend raking?

problem: The sewing club meets in room 14 every Thursday. This week the members are making aprons for the school kitchen. They finish 7 aprons, and every apron has 3 pockets. How many pockets do they sew?

follow_ups.question: Each pocket is trimmed with 2 strips of lace. How many strips of lace do they need?

problem: Tomas builds a wall of blocks across his bedroom doorway to keep the new puppy out. The wall is 5 rows high and 9 blocks long. How many blocks did he need for it?
A grocery store sends bread to the food bank every week. This week the baker packed 14 trays, each with 6 rolls. The rolls were still warm when they arrived. How many rolls did the food bank receive?

follow_ups.question: The rolls are put into bags of 4 for families. How many bags can be filled?
By closing time, 15 bags have been given out. How many bags are left?
The leftover bags are split evenly between 2 shelters. How many bags does each shelter get?

problem: A teacher takes her art group to the post office to mail cards to a sister school abroad. The 9 children in the group have written 3 cards apiece. Altogether, how many cards go in the mail?

follow_ups.question: Every card needs one stamp, and stamps are sold in strips of 9. How many strips do they buy?
A strip costs 8 dollars. How much do they pay for the stamps?

problem: Before school starts, the eye clinic checks how well children can read letters from far away. On the walls hang 4 charts, and Dr Mensah has printed 8 rows of letters on each. In all, how many rows of letters are there?

follow_ups.question: One girl reads every row on 3 of the charts. How many rows did she read?

problem: This spring the fire station received 6 new hoses, each 25 metres long. Chief Okafor, who has worked there for 18 years, signed for the delivery. How many metres of new hose did the station get?

follow_ups.question: The crew rolls out 4 of the hoses to test them. How many metres of hose are rolled out?
How many metres of the new hose are still rolled up?

problem: Everyone on a building site must wear a hard hat, so spare hats wait in crates by the gate. With 6 hats in each of the 5 crates, how many spare hard hats are there?
On a rainy Monday, Ximena spent the day fixing tricycles at the bike shop. She put new tyres on all the wheels of 7 tricycles. A tricycle has 3 wheels, so how many tyres did she fit?

follow_ups.question: Each tyre costs 5 dollars. What did the new tyres cost altogether?

problem: The flower shop is decorating the tables for a school dinner. A pot of 4 sunflowers will go on every table, and there are 8 tables. The school hall has big windows along the back wall. How many sunflowers does the florist need?

follow_ups.question: She already has 20 sunflowers in the cold room. How many more must she order?
Sunflowers arrive in bunches of 3. How many bunches does she order?
If each bunch costs 6 dollars, how much does she spend on the order?

problem: To guide visitors through the corn maze beside the pumpkin patch at night, Wiremu sets lanterns along the paths. The maze has 5 paths, and he places 16 lanterns on each. How many lanterns does he need?

follow_ups.question: Each lantern takes 3 batteries. How many batteries is that?

problem: There are 26 food stands at the county fair this year, but the children love the petting zoo most. Its 6 pens hold 5 goats apiece. Find the number of goats at the petting zoo.

follow_ups.question: In the afternoon each goat is fed 2 carrots. How many carrots are eaten?
The keeper brought 75 carrots that day. How many carrots are left over?

problem: Sports day always ends with tug-of-war because everyone can join in. Each rope team has 7 pupils, and 4 teams take part. Can you work out how many pupils are pulling on ropes?
The sewing club is making bunting to hang over the town's summer festival. They sew 5 strings of bunting, and a string has 18 flags on it. How many flags do they sew?

follow_ups.question: They also cut 6 spare flags in case some get torn. How many flags did they make in all?

problem: Grandpa Abebe gave the twins a big box of building blocks. They decided to build a car park with 4 levels, and each level has room for 9 toy cars. How many cars can park in it?

follow_ups.question: The twins own only 28 toy cars. How many spaces stay empty?
Then their cousin brings 5 more cars to park. How many spaces are empty now?

problem: Every winter the food bank hands out warm socks along with food. This year volunteers tied up 9 bundles with 3 pairs of socks in each. The socks were knitted by a group of grandmothers. How many pairs of socks are in the bundles?

follow_ups.question: On the first day, 4 bundles are given away. How many pairs of socks are still in bundles?

problem: The post office has a wall of small mailboxes that people can rent. The wall has 8 rows of 12 boxes. The office opens at 9 every morning. What is the total number of mailboxes on the wall?

follow_ups.question: All but 15 of the boxes are rented. How many boxes are rented?
Next month, 7 of the empty boxes get rented too. How many boxes are empty now?
The manager then adds 2 new rows of 12 boxes. How many empty boxes are there after that?

problem: Hamid's doctor likes to keep the waiting room cheerful for young patients. Four baskets of picture books sit by the chairs, with 7 books in every basket. How many picture books can children choose from?

The fire crew is visiting a school to talk about smoke alarms, and they plan to give some to families who need one. They load 6 spare alarms onto each of their 3 fire trucks. Find how many spare alarms they bring.

follow_ups.question: At the school they give away 2 alarms from every truck. How many alarms do they give away?
How many spare alarms are left on the trucks?

problem: Fence panels are going up around the building site so no one can wander in. The site has 4 sides, and each side needs 9 panels. How many panels are needed?

follow_ups.question: Workers hang 2 warning signs on every panel. How many signs do they hang?

problem: The bike shop is getting bikes ready for a charity ride on Sunday. On Saturday the mechanic, Ulla, puts new brakes on 14 bikes, using 4 brake pads per bike. How many brake pads does she use?

follow_ups.question: She started the day with 72 brake pads. How many does she have left?
On Sunday morning she uses the rest to fix more bikes, again putting the same number of pads on each bike. How many bikes does she fix on Sunday?

problem: A café 3 streets away from Paloma's flower shop orders small posies for its tables. Paloma ties together 8 posies of 5 daisies each. How many daisies does she use?

follow_ups.question: The café then asks for 2 extra posies of the same size. How many daisies does she use in all?

problem: At the end of the season, the pumpkin patch sells its smallest pumpkins in net bags. The farmer drops 6 pumpkins into each bag until 7 bags are full. The nets are bright orange so shoppers can spot them. How many small pumpkins go into the bags?
The Ferris wheel at the county fair has 16 cars, and each car seats 4 people. If every seat is taken on the last ride of the night, how many people are riding?

follow_ups.question: Each rider hands over 3 tickets. How many tickets is that?
The operator stacks the tickets in piles of 8. How many piles does she make?
She puts 2 piles into each envelope. How many envelopes does she need?

problem: The sack race needs plenty of sacks. The teachers drop 3 sacks at the start of each of the 6 lanes, one for each runner in a heat. How many sacks are on the field?

follow_ups.question: Before the race, 4 of the sacks are found to have holes and are thrown away. How many sacks are left?
A parent brings 7 new sacks from home. How many sacks can be used now?

problem: Mrs Ivanova is teaching the sewing club how to make pincushions. The club makes 9 pincushions, and each one is stuffed with 4 handfuls of cotton wool. How much cotton wool do they use, in handfuls?

follow_ups.question: There are 5 children in the club, and each keeps one pincushion. The rest go to a care home. How many pincushions go to the care home?

problem: Daria is building a castle out of blocks for a school project that is due in 4 days. The castle has 6 walls, and each wall uses 23 blocks. How many blocks are in the walls?

follow_ups.question: The towers on top use 35 more blocks. How many blocks are in the whole castle?
Her block set came in 2 boxes of 95 blocks. How many blocks did she not use?

problem: Scouts spent Saturday morning sorting donated pasta at the food bank. Each crate takes exactly 6 packets, and by lunch they had filled 8 crates. Altogether, how many packets of pasta did the scouts sort?

Wen works at the post office counter, where envelopes are sold in packs of 5. This morning she sold 8 packs. A parrot in the pet shop next door whistled the whole time. How many envelopes did she sell?

follow_ups.question: After lunch, she sells 3 more packs. How many envelopes has she sold today?

problem: The children's clinic gives every patient a sticker after a check-up. The stickers come on sheets, and each sheet is printed with 6 rows of 4 stickers. How many stickers are on a sheet?

follow_ups.question: The nurse uses 3 full sheets in one morning. How many stickers is that?
Each child gets 2 stickers. How many children did the nurse see that morning?
In the afternoon she sees 9 fewer children than in the morning. How many children does she see in the afternoon?

problem: Firefighters climb the stairs of the training tower to stay fit. The tower has 12 flights, and each flight has 15 steps. To reach the top, how many steps must they climb?

follow_ups.question: Elif climbs to the top 4 times in one practice. How many steps does she climb?

problem: A crane is lifting steel beams up to the 9th floor of a new hospital. Each bundle holds 4 beams, and the crane lifts 6 bundles before lunch. How many beams does it lift?

follow_ups.question: After lunch it lifts 5 more bundles of the same size. How many beams has it lifted in all?
The builders need 50 beams for the floor. How many more beams must be lifted?

problem: For bike-to-school week, the bike shop lends helmets to children who do not have one. The helmets are packed into 5 bins, and Lars counts 7 helmets in every bin. How many helmets can be lent out?
A hotel orders flowers for the 13 tables in its dining room, and the flower shop must place 7 roses on every table. Exactly how many roses must the florist prepare?

follow_ups.question: She had 99 roses in the shop. How many will she have left?

problem: Bao spends Halloween night at the pumpkin patch carving lanterns. He carves 3 pumpkins for each of his 6 cousins. A light rain starts falling in the evening. How many pumpkins does Bao carve?

follow_ups.question: Each lantern gets 2 candles inside. How many candles does Bao need?
Candles come in boxes of 9. How many boxes is that?

problem: In the sheep barn at the county fair, the sheep are kept in pens so the judges can look at them. The barn has 8 pens, and the judges find 5 sheep in every one. What is the number of sheep in the barn?

follow_ups.question: Ribbons go to 3 sheep from every pen. How many sheep win ribbons?

problem: The obstacle course starts at 2 o'clock, and Mr Tanaka is still setting it up. He puts 18 cones in each of the 4 lanes. How many cones does he need?

follow_ups.question: He has 85 cones in the storage room. How many cones are left there?
He decides to add one more lane with the same number of cones. How many extra cones must he borrow?
He borrows them from Ms Ahmed, who has 3 boxes of 9 cones. How many cones does Ms Ahmed have left?

problem: Little bags of lavender make lovely gifts, so the sewing club sews some for the school fair. The club's 7 members make 4 bags each. Find the club's total number of lavender bags.
Zainab's baby brother keeps knocking her block towers over, so she builds lots of small ones. She builds 6 towers that are each 5 blocks tall. How many blocks does she use?

follow_ups.question: Her brother knocks down 2 towers. How many blocks fall?
How many blocks are still standing?

problem: Before school, Pita's family drops off apples at the food bank. They carried in 4 baskets from the tree in their garden, and there were 9 apples in every basket. How many apples did they give?

follow_ups.question: The food bank puts 6 apples in each family's bag. How many bags get apples?

problem: The post office truck makes 5 trips to the airport each day. On every trip it carries 19 sacks of letters. The truck is painted red and yellow. How many sacks does it carry in a day?

follow_ups.question: On Friday the truck makes 2 extra trips with the same load. How many sacks does it carry on Friday?
On Saturday it makes only 3 trips. How many fewer sacks does it carry than on Friday?

problem: Dr Osei's clinic has a fresh coat of paint, and now the waiting room needs new chairs. She orders enough chairs for 3 rows, 8 chairs to a row. The chairs will arrive in 10 days. How many chairs does she order?

follow_ups.question: She also orders one cushion for every chair plus 4 spares. How many cushions does she order?

problem: When the alarm rings, every firefighter grabs a helmet from the rack by the door. The rack has 4 shelves with 5 helmets on each shelf. How many helmets are on the rack?
Builders are laying paving stones for a new path to the school. The path is 25 stones long and 3 stones wide. How many paving stones do they need?

follow_ups.question: The stones come on pallets of 15. How many pallets are delivered?
Then the school asks for the path to be 2 stones wider but just as long. How many stones will the path need now?
How many more stones is that than the first plan?

problem: A cycling club rents bikes from the shop for a long ride around the lake. The club has 7 riders, and each needs 3 water bottles for the trip. How many water bottles does the shop sell them?

follow_ups.question: The shop had 50 water bottles that morning. How many are left?
Then a second club buys 3 bottles for each of its 6 riders. How many bottles does the shop have now?

problem: For the school play, the flower shop is making bouquets for the actors to carry on stage. Each bouquet has 9 carnations, and the director needs 4 bouquets. What is the total number of carnations needed?

follow_ups.question: The director then asks for one bouquet less. How many carnations are needed now?

problem: The hayride wagon at the pumpkin patch has 12 benches, and 5 people fit on each bench. A ride around the field lasts 20 minutes. How many people can ride at once?

follow_ups.question: On the first ride, 7 seats are empty. How many people are on that ride?
On the next ride every seat is full. How many people have ridden on the two rides together?

problem: Inside the quilting tent at the county fair, the quilts hang from ropes. Along each of the 5 ropes hang 4 quilts. A brass band is playing just outside the tent. How many quilts are on display?
Water stations are set up along the track so no one gets thirsty on sports day. At every one of the 6 stations, a helper lines up 8 cups. How many cups are ready?

follow_ups.question: By the end of the day only 5 cups are unused. How many cups were used?

problem: Ms Bello's sewing club is making sock puppets for story hour at the library. A puppet needs 2 button eyes, and the club has made 9 puppets. What is the total number of buttons used for eyes?

follow_ups.question: They also sew 3 buttons down the front of each puppet's coat. How many coat buttons is that?
How many buttons do they use altogether?
Their button tin held 60 buttons. How many buttons are left in the tin?

problem: Kaito is building a model city with interlocking blocks. Every skyscraper takes 24 blocks, and he has built 4 of them. How many blocks went into the skyscrapers?

follow_ups.question: He also builds 3 small houses that use 15 blocks each. How many blocks are in the city now?

problem: This year 32 volunteers signed up for the food bank's holiday drive. Mr Rahman's job is packing peanut butter: he packs 6 jars into a box and fills 7 boxes. How many jars does he pack?

follow_ups.question: Each family gets 3 jars. How many families can get peanut butter?
Only 9 families come on the first day. How many jars are left after they collect theirs?

problem: What a busy morning at the post office! People mailed 9 boxes of homemade cookies to relatives far away, and each box held 4 bags of cookies. Work out the number of cookie bags that were mailed.
The pharmacy at the clinic keeps vitamin bottles on a tall shelf. The bottles stand in 6 rows of 17. The shelf was built by a local carpenter. How many bottles are on the shelf?

follow_ups.question: The pharmacist takes 9 bottles down to restock the counter. How many bottles are left on the shelf?

problem: The firefighters are cooking a pancake breakfast to raise money for new boots. In the first hour they serve 9 plates, with 3 pancakes on every plate. How many pancakes do they cook in that hour?

follow_ups.question: In the second hour they serve twice as many plates. How many plates is that?
How many pancakes do they cook in the second hour?

problem: A bricklayer at the building site needs mortar for a new chimney. She mixes 8 buckets of it, and each bucket needs 3 scoops of cement. Find how many scoops of cement she uses.

follow_ups.question: One bag of cement holds 12 scoops. How many bags does she open?

problem: A school with a bike club of 45 members wants a lock for every bike rack. It buys 8 boxes of locks from the bike shop, and each box holds 12 locks. How many locks does the school buy?

follow_ups.question: It fixes 6 locks to each rack. How many racks get locks?
Later the school buys 2 more boxes of 12 locks. How many locks has it bought now?
Each lock cost 3 dollars. How much did all the locks cost?

problem: Sakura grows seedlings to sell at her flower shop in spring. Each morning she fills one window box with 5 seedlings, and she has done this for 8 mornings in a row. How many seedlings has she planted?
Visitors at the pumpkin patch can buy caramel apples on sticks. Finn, the farmer's son, has made 4 trays, and a tray holds 6 apples. Before the gates open, how many caramel apples are ready to sell?

follow_ups.question: He sells 19 of them by lunch. How many are left?
He then makes 2 more trays. How many caramel apples does he have now?

problem: The honey tent at the county fair has a stand with 3 shelves, and 9 jars sit on each shelf. Most of the honey came from farms in the hills. How many jars of honey are on the stand?

follow_ups.question: The judges open 2 jars from every shelf to taste. How many jars do they open?

problem: Medals for sports day come in flat boxes. Mrs Kowalski opens 7 boxes, and each box holds 14 medals. Find the number of medals she has to give out.

follow_ups.question: She gives 9 medals at each event, and there are 8 events. How many medals are left?
The leftover medals are split equally between the 2 school houses for next year. How many does each house get?

problem: There are 15 spools of thread in the sewing club's cupboard. For the club banner, each of the 6 members sews 5 patches. How many patches go onto the banner?

follow_ups.question: Each patch gets 4 sequins. How many sequins are needed?

problem: In the preschool play corner, the teacher sorts building blocks into bins by colour. There are 7 colours and 9 blocks of each colour. If every block is put away, how many blocks are in the bins?
A dairy farm donates milk to the food bank every week. This week the farm sent 6 crates, and every crate holds 16 cartons. How many cartons of milk did the food bank get?

follow_ups.question: Each family takes home 2 cartons. How many families can get milk?
Only 39 families come this week. How many cartons are left?
The leftover cartons are shared equally among 3 school breakfast clubs. How many cartons does each club get?

problem: Mr Petrov sorts letters into pigeonholes at the post office, one pigeonhole for each street. He puts 7 letters into each of the 9 pigeonholes. How many letters does he sort?

follow_ups.question: He then sorts 9 more letters for a new street. How many letters has he sorted now?
He ties the letters into bundles of 8 for the carriers. How many bundles does he make?

problem: During the school health check, Dr Yusuf weighs children in small groups. He sees 5 groups of 6 children. The scale in his room is shiny and new. How many children does he weigh?

follow_ups.question: Each child also gets 2 sugar-free lollies. How many lollies does Dr Yusuf hand out?

problem: A fire station holds a car wash to raise money for a new ladder, which the crew hopes to buy within 6 months. In the morning they wash 13 cars, using 4 buckets of soapy water on each car. How many buckets of soapy water do they use?

follow_ups.question: In the afternoon they wash 9 more cars. How many buckets do the afternoon cars use?
How many buckets do they use for the whole day?

problem: A new playground is being built next to the school. To hold up the climbing frame, the workers set 6 wooden posts in the ground each day, and the job takes 4 days. Can you find how many posts they set?
Reflective stickers at the bike shop come in strips of 8. Nikolai buys 3 strips to decorate his scooter and his bike. How many stickers does he get?

follow_ups.question: He puts 9 stickers on his scooter and the rest on his bike. How many go on his bike?

problem: It is Valentine's Day, and the flower shop has run out of red ribbon! The owner ties each bouquet with 2 pieces of white ribbon instead. She makes 9 bouquets this morning. How many pieces of ribbon does she use?

follow_ups.question: Each bouquet has 7 roses. How many roses are in the bouquets?
She had 80 roses before she started. How many roses are left?
With the roses that are left she makes 2 more bouquets of 7. How many roses does she still have after that?

problem: The pumpkin patch is shipping pumpkins to a supermarket in the city. The truck carries 9 crates, and each crate holds 18 pumpkins. Work out how many pumpkins are on the truck.

follow_ups.question: When the truck arrives, 7 of the pumpkins are bruised and sent back. How many does the supermarket keep?

problem: Selin sells lemonade at the county fair from a stand right next to gate 4. She has 6 jugs, and each jug fills 7 cups. How many cups of lemonade can she pour?

follow_ups.question: By the end of the day, 35 cups have been sold. How many cups were not sold?
Each cup sold for 2 dollars. How much money did Selin take in?

problem: Every class carries its own flag in the sports day parade. The flags are kept in 3 boxes, with 7 flags in each box. The parade goes all the way around the field. How many flags are there?
The sewing club is making a dozen cushions for the reading corner. Each cushion is decorated with 8 felt stars. How many felt stars does the club cut out?

follow_ups.question: One sheet of felt makes 6 stars. How many sheets do they need?

problem: Yara and her dad build a bridge out of blocks for her toy train. The bridge stands on 4 pillars, and each pillar is 7 blocks tall. How many blocks are in the pillars?

follow_ups.question: The top of the bridge uses 12 more blocks. How many blocks does the whole bridge use?
Her block box had 50 blocks. How many blocks are left in the box?

problem: School children made breakfast packs for the food bank during their lunch break. They made 8 packs and put 3 cereal bars in each. Find how many cereal bars they used.

follow_ups.question: A teacher made another 5 packs the same way. How many cereal bars are in all the packs now?

problem: The post office on Elm Street is open 6 days a week. On Monday the van brings 3 trolleys of parcels, and each trolley carries 28 parcels. How many parcels arrive on Monday?

follow_ups.question: The clerk places the parcels on shelves, 12 to a shelf. How many shelves does she fill?
On Tuesday 2 trolleys of the same size come. How many parcels arrive on the two days together?
By Wednesday, 95 of those parcels have been delivered. How many are still waiting?

problem: The physio at the clinic gives Jorge exercises for his sore knee. He must do 9 knee lifts every day for a week. Over the whole week, how many knee lifts does he do?
To teach children about safety, the fire crew hands out activity books at the library. They bring 5 boxes, and each box has 9 books. How many activity books do they bring?

follow_ups.question: They give away all but 6 of the books. How many books are given away?
Each child who got a book also gets 2 crayons. How many crayons do they hand out?
